prompt:
Our company (Pinnacle Retail Group) has a commercial lease dispute with our landlord going to mediation next week over a significant HVAC failure incident. Our General Counsel needs a comprehensive briefing document saved as `mediation_brief.md` that our legal team can use to prepare.

The document should cover the full step-by-step mediation process, the techniques the mediator is likely to deploy during the session, everything our settlement agreement must include to be enforceable, and a complete readiness checklist our counsel can use before and during the session.

We have an internal ADR reference tool available in the workspace — please use it to build this brief. The legal team will be checking it against the tool's own guidance, so it must be accurate and complete.
